app.name: VieWallet
app.simulationNotice: Simulation environment — no real money, no real banks.

home.title: Welcome to VieWallet
home.intro: Create a simulated account to get started. Wallet, deposits and transfers arrive in the next phases.
home.signedInIntro: Your balance and recent transactions are below.

status.errorDescription: Check that the backend is running, then try again.
status.offline: You are offline. Data may be out of date; actions need a connection.

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tryLater: Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.pinResetRequired: The PIN was locked several times. Reset it with your password and an e-mail code.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A memorable phrase works well; do not use your e-mail or name.
fields.passwordWeak: Password is not strong enough: at least 10 characters, not a common one, and not containing your e-mail or name.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to manage your simulated wallet.
login.notVerified: Your e-mail is not verified yet.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: It takes a minute. We will e-mail you a verification code.
register.simulationBody: No real money is involved. Use fictional details, never real personal data.

verify.title: Verify your e-mail
verify.description: Enter the 6-digit code we just sent you.
verify.codeHint: The code is valid for 15 minutes.
verify.resent: If the address is valid, a new code was sent.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your e-mail and we will send a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If the address has an account, a reset link (valid for 30 minutes) was sent.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.description: After the change every signed-in device is signed out.
reset.done: Password changed. Please sign in again.
reset.missingToken: Invalid link. Open the exact link from the e-mail.

pin.title: Transaction PIN
pin.rules: A 6-digit PIN confirms every payment out of your wallet. Avoid easy sequences like 123456 or 111111. Five wrong tries lock it for 30 minutes.

setup.title: Set your transaction PIN
setup.description: Last step before using the wallet.

pin.missingTitle: You have not set a transaction PIN yet.
pin.sendResetCode: E-mail me a PIN reset code
pin.codeSent: A PIN reset code was sent to your e-mail.

security.title: Account security
security.description: Manage your password, transaction PIN and signed-in devices.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing the password signs out every other device.

wallet.title: My wallet
wallet.description: Other VieWallet users send money to your wallet number.
wallet.frozenSelf: You froze this wallet. All transactions are paused; unfreeze it with your transaction PIN.
wallet.frozenStaff: Support has frozen this wallet. Please contact support to unfreeze it.
wallet.freezeBody: Use this if you lost your phone or suspect someone else is using your wallet. A frozen wallet cannot send or receive money. You can unfreeze it with your PIN.
wallet.unfreezeBody: Enter your transaction PIN to unfreeze.
wallet.comingSoon: Transfers and QR payments arrive in later phases.

history.title: Transaction history
history.description: Every transaction of your wallet, newest first.
history.emptyBody: Your transactions will show up here.
history.search: Search by reference, message or counterparty

export.title: Export CSV
export.gone: The file expired. Create it again.

txn.notFoundBody: It does not exist or does not belong to your wallet.

money.scenarioHint: The amount picks a SimBank scenario: …111,000 fails, …222,000 completes after 2 minutes, …777,000 bank unavailable. Anything else succeeds.
money.stillWaiting: Still processing. You can leave this page; we will notify you of the result.

failure.CUSTOMER_DECLINED: You declined the payment at the bank.
failure.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The bank is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
failure.ACCOUNT_CLOSED: The receiving account is closed or invalid.
failure.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your balance does not cover the amount and fee.
failure.PAYOUT_FAILED: The bank did not accept the payout.
failure.RECIPIENT_UNAVAILABLE: The recipient cannot receive money right now.
failure.RECEIVER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The recipient reached their balance limit.
failure.PAYMENT_REQUEST_CLOSED: The payment request is closed (paid, expired or cancelled).
failure.REVIEW_REJECTED: Not approved after a safety check. The money is back in your wallet.
failure.REVIEW_EXPIRED: The safety check timed out. The money is back in your wallet.
failure.TXN_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Identity verification (KYC) is required for this.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.description: Simulated top-up from SimBank to your wallet.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.description: Simulated withdrawal to a saved bank account.
withdraw.kycRequired: Identity verification (KYC) is required to withdraw
withdraw.kycBody: KYC arrives in Phase 6. In the simulation, developers can raise the tier with a CLI command.
withdraw.noDestination: You have not saved a bank account yet.
withdraw.refunded: The money was returned to your wallet.
withdraw.pending: Money on hold, waiting to be sent
withdraw.reversed: The bank returned the payout. Amount and fee were credited back.

destinations.title: Bank accounts
destinations.description: Up to 5 accounts at simulated banks. A new account must wait 1 hour before it can receive.
destinations.fictional: Use fictional details only. Never enter a real account number.

warning.NEW_RECIPIENT: First transfer to this person. Check the name carefully.
warning.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: You just sent this exact amount to the same person. Is this a duplicate?

spend.reviewBody: The money is on hold while we check (up to 72 hours). If not approved, it returns to your wallet.

transfer.title: Send money
transfer.description: Instant transfers to another VieWallet wallet.

pay.title: Pay
pay.description: Check who you pay before paying.
pay.openAmount: The shop lets you enter the amount.

scan.title: Scan a QR code
scan.description: Scan a shop QR, a money request or a friend's receive QR.
scan.unsupported: This browser cannot scan with the camera yet. Enter the code below.
scan.denied: Could not open the camera. Allow camera access or enter the code below.
scan.code: Payment code, wallet number or link
scan.codeHint: For example the 16-character code under the QR, or a 10-digit wallet number.
scan.invalid: Code not recognised. Only VieWallet codes can be opened.

receive.title: Receive money
receive.description: Show this code so others can send you money.

request.title: Request money
request.description: Ask someone to pay you an amount.

empty.issued: You have not requested money yet.

request.payerHint: E-mail or wallet number. Empty: anyone with the code can pay.
request.payerInvalid: Enter an e-mail or a 10-digit wallet number.

merchant.title: Shop
merchant.description: Simulated shop: create QR codes, see payments, refund.
merchant.none: You do not have a shop
merchant.noneBody: Simulated shops are created with the create_merchant command in development.
merchant.amountHint: Leave empty to let the customer enter the amount.
merchant.refundBody: Payment {{reference}}. The money leaves the shop wallet and reaches the customer at once.
merchant.tooMuch: More than what is still refundable.

kyc.title: Identity verification (KYC)
kyc.description: Verify to withdraw and to get higher limits.
kyc.simulatedBody: Do not upload a real identity document. Use fictional details and sample images.
kyc.numberSaved: Saved: {{masked}}. Type it again to change it.
kyc.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
kyc.fileHint: JPEG, PNG or PDF up to 5 MB. Images are re-encoded and EXIF data is removed.
kyc.waitingBody: Staff will check your simulated submission. You will be notified of the result.
kyc.tryAgain: You can correct it and submit again.
kyc.expired: Your verification expired. Please submit again.

reason.MISMATCH: The details do not match the document.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: What is left for your verification tier.
limits.notAllowed: Identity verification is required for this.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Fictional personal details of the simulated account.
profile.phoneHint: Vietnamese mobile number, e.g. 0912345678. Not verified by SMS.
profile.nameLocked: Your identity is verified, so the name cannot change.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Applies on every device you sign in on.
settings.privacyHint: Balances and amounts in lists stay hidden until you reveal them.

recipients.title: Saved recipients
recipients.description: People you often send money to.

support.title: Support
support.description: Send a request and follow the support team's answers.
support.subject: Subject
support.noSecrets: Never send your PIN, password or verification codes.
support.closedNote: This request is closed. Open a new one if needed.
